method: Assistant visual inspection of all six new backgrounds against the accepted station and cover; no people, legible lettering, logos or UI strips observed.
notes: Tundra: firm dry path, snow in hollows, dwarf willows, no animals/nests or unsafe crossing. Small roofed equipment support without writing.
Equipment and listening rooms: consistent timber station, plain unbranded devices, dark screens, clear floor.
Porch: covered, dry clear walkway, patchy snow outside; neutral lighting supports arrival and evening.
Storm: same station room viewed safely from inside, window obscured by snow, guarded stove and glass-shielded table lamp; no rescue or power-outage implied.
Screening: modest multipurpose station room, blank portable screen, plain chairs, no signage.
